about: THE CARDPUTERS' pictures (C-393): the Cardputer Zero's program on a computer, filed in qa/screenshots/2026-11-16 (C-377, C-380, C-381) and 2026-11-17 (C-395 GAMES, C-397 RECEIVED), each cropped to one 320x170 screen. Nothing of the Cardputer or the ADV is captured by any tool yet, and nothing of the Zero on the device itself; its drawings are in diagrams/.
